steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; foreach (array('sample-page','privacy-policy') as $slug) { $p = get_page_by_path($slug); if ($p) { wp_delete_post($p->ID, true); } } $hello = get_page_by_path('hello-world', OBJECT, 'post'); if ($hello) { wp_delete_post($hello->ID, true); } $pages = array('Home','Divisions','About','Gallery','Contact'); $ids = array(); $order = 1; foreach ($pages as $title) { $slug = sanitize_title($title); $existing = get_page_by_path($slug); if ($existing) { $ids[$title] = $existing->ID; wp_update_post(array('ID'=>$existing->ID,'menu_order'=>$order)); } else { $ids[$title] = wp_insert_post(array('post_title'=>$title,'post_name'=>$slug,'post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_content'=>'','menu_order'=>$order)); } $order++; } update_option('show_on_front','page'); update_option('page_on_front',$ids['Home']);
